description: This file contains the implementation of a grain locator class 'DhtGrainLocator' used within the Orleans distributed application framework. It manages registration, lookup, cache management, and deregistration of grains in a distributed system, including internal batch processing for deregistration tasks.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocator
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainLocator that leverages an in-memory distributed directory for grain address management within Orleans.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocator.BatchedDeregistrationWorker
classes.description: A private internal class responsible for batching and processing deregistration requests asynchronously in the background.

methods.name: DhtGrainLocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the locator with local grain directory and grain context.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address of a grain by its ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address based on the cause, batching deregistration asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a specific grain ID and silo address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a grain ID or specific grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find a grain address in the cache for a given grain ID.

methods.name: FromLocalGrainDirectory
methods.description: Factory method to create a DhtGrainLocator from a LocalGrainDirectory instance.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Method in BatchedDeregistrationWorker for queuing deregistration requests.
